tools.name: search_reveal_ideas
tools.description: Returns ideas from revelationbaby.com for revealing to family and friends whether the baby is a girl or a boy, so that everyone discovers the answer together. Each idea comes with a link to its page. Use it when someone asks how to share this news with loved ones, at home, at a party or from afar.

tools.name: get_how_it_works
tools.description: Explains, step by step, how a live girl-or-boy reveal works on revelationbaby.com: the parents prepare it, invite their circle by link or QR code, guests share their intuitions, then everyone sees the answer at the same time.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Searches the official revelationbaby.com FAQ and returns up to three matching questions with their exact answers and a link. Use it for questions about guests, privacy of the answer, the healthcare provider mode, the trusted person or changing the date.

tools.name: get_hosting_guide
tools.description: Returns practical steps from revelationbaby.com for hosting a girl-or-boy reveal with family and friends, in person, at a party or from afar, and for choosing who keeps the answer until the reveal.

tools.name: get_demo_link
tools.description: Returns the link to the revelationbaby.com demo, where anyone can try a pretend reveal without signing up. The people and the result in the demo are made up.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Returns the current revelationbaby.com plans with their exact prices in euros, as shown on the pricing page, and a link to that page. Taking part stays free for guests.
